rationale_one_line: A terminal-native monospace brand (OpenCode) for a terminal-native Claude Code plugin, with RECEIPT letting the zero-token cost be the headline.
writing_tone_notes: Plain, build-in-public, unhyped. Specifics over adjectives, the contrast carries the praise. Mirror the creator's precise README voice. Numbers do the proving.
do_rules: Lead the receipt with the 0-token summarization cost
Show the terminal and the session-to-digest flow, do not narrate them
Keep every surface in monospace register, sharp 0px containers
Use the deep-blue accent sparingly on the emphasis beats
dont_rules: No version numbers anywhere in copy
No superlatives, no hype, let the numbers carry it
Do not repeat the token-cost phrasing verbatim across scenes
No sans-serif, no rounded cards, no gradients
